# Every place outside the generated files that spells out a pinned version from Tools~/versions.env.
# One per line: <kind>|<path>|<regex>. Group 1 of the regex is the version. kind is ios, android or gradleplugin.
# Read by update-native-sdks.sh (rewrites group 1) and Tests~/WrapperPolicy/WrapperIdentityDriftTests.cs (fails on drift).
# Keep regexes to syntax Python and .NET share. A pattern that matches nothing fails both.
# In CHANGELOG.md only the first (current) version section is read and rewritten; released sections keep their history.
# Not here: Tests~/iOS/run-tests.sh CHECKSUM (a hash of the zip, not derivable; the script warns when the zip version moves).
